name: desktop-artifact-json-visibility
goal: Capture the complete opened recorded JSON after its reactive content renders

evidence: Self-review of canonical RuntimeArtifact json-open images at64b10df9bb found only the heading and top border of its JSON; all three viewport crops exclude the opened content.

Existing action only counted open details, satisfied by the outer disclosure, while the nested JSON body mounts after the native toggle event. Add a post-capture geometry assertion against the original retained crop in the same three standardized cases.
